faq.question: Q1. What is the High Court of J&K and Ladakh District Judge Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh to fill 11 posts of District Judge through a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies available for the post of District Judge.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Civil Judges (Senior Division) having a minimum of three years' service as Civil Judge (Senior Division) with a minimum of seven years' total service rendered as Civil Judge (Junior Division) and Civil Judge (Senior Division) are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for the District Judge post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a pay scale in Level J-5 (144840-194660).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by logging in to the official web portal at exams.jklhc.in between 3 October 2026 and 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a written examination (180 marks), performance assessment (80 marks), and viva voce (20 marks).

faq.question: Q9. What is the exam pattern for the written examination?
faq.answer: The written examination consists of Paper I on Laws and Procedure for 100 marks (3 hours duration) and Paper II for judgment writing for 80 marks (90 minutes duration).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification?
faq.answer: Candidates can view and download the official notification from the official High Court web portal.
